name: input
title: Input
description: A polished form input primitive for app interfaces. It handles labels, helper text, error messaging, icon slots, clearable values, disabled and read-only states, and small/default/large sizing from one installable component.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/input.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add input.
